content: {"like":["Enjoys fresh characters in long-running police dramas like CHiPs season 6","Prefers original order and length in classic TV series such as Lone Ranger","Values remastered image quality in vintage comedy collections like Laurel & Hardy","Appreciates standalone highlights in action comedies such as Chips (DVD)","Likes campy, non-canon Star Wars specials for their nostalgic appeal"],"dislike":["Dislikes seasons that lose key characters between installments, e.g., CHiPs 5-6","Avoids far‑fetched sci‑fi plots in procedural shows, like robots in CHiPs","Rejects poorly acted, emotionally flat adaptations of classic literature, e.g., A Christmas Carol","Finds spoof-heavy detective series like Sherlock Holmes unappealing","Dislikes non‑canonical Star Wars content that mixes old and new footage"]}
